sentence: This project builds a computer model that uses machine learning to predict how rotating detonation engine flows behave.
This project studies how ant colonies regulate their energy use and uses what it learns to design robotic swarms that do the same.
This project builds a computer method that predicts how well a small molecule binds to a protein, to help find drug candidates early.
This project develops diagrams that help describe and compute with structures called quantum groups.
This project designs materials that can control light in unusual ways, using computer simulations and by growing single crystals and thin films.
This project builds an automated machine that tests how a patient's cancer responds to drugs using slices of fresh human tumor tissue.
This project tests whether ecological forecasts and messaging campaigns can help communities reduce artificial lights at night that harm migrant birds.
This project studies which sets can be defined in algebra and geometry using a branch of mathematics called model theory.
This project surveys fungi carried in the seeds of flowering plants to find out how they affect the diversity of plants.
This project builds a neural network that uses genetic changes and community structure to predict how microbiomes work.
This project tests whether networks formed by ferromagnetic colloids in a magnetic field are in equilibrium or stuck.
This project studies how well digital twins, which are computer models of physical systems, predict outcomes under conditions they have not previously encountered.
This project compares the genomes of seahorses and pipefishes to learn how sexual selection and sexual conflict affect genome evolution.
This project develops open-source hardware and software for building instruments that process signals from radio telescopes.
This project builds a mobile tool that uses artificial intelligence and computer vision to assess hair and scalp conditions.
